name: scaffold-gain-audit-20260825
description: Measure whether reported scaffold and prompt-level improvements survive a standard strict enough to refuse a result. The 2026 self-evolution line (Evo-Bench 2608.09096, EvoAgentBench 2607.05202, Gated Semantic Quality-Diversity 2607.13683, SIA 2605.27276) has settled that a search loop can improve an agent harness, and Evo-Bench reports gains above sixteen points from a single run with no statistical testing and no confidence intervals. The unified-evaluation line (2605.27898) holds the scaffold constant to remove it as a confounder. Neither occupies the intersection: a searched scaffold change, measured to a standard that can withhold a verdict. Each candidate here re-measures one specific published or self-generated scaffold claim under equal generation budgets, at or above the 200-sample floor, with a paired permutation test, and reports accuracy per metered token rather than accuracy alone. A candidate that cannot name the claim it is re-measuring does not belong in this agenda.

anchor_claims: 2605.08478: repeated independent sampling beats agent-based reasoning on accuracy per dollar and per call; agent frameworks show lower per-call effectiveness
2608.09096: a search loop improves a seed harness by more than sixteen points, reported from one run without intervals
internal: prompt interventions moved numeric_accuracy 0.32 to 0.63 on a 0.32-baseline task, and produced at most +1.5 points across 26 runs on 0.67-0.82 baselines
prefer.derived_from: experiment_run 246 / scientific_decision_record 98, and the 2026-08-25 external survey

keywords: build a new scaffold search loop
demonstrate that search improves a harness
reject.reason: V1 registers two runners, generative_qa and sequence_classification, whose candidate hook is the prompt or the input text. Demonstrating that scaffold search works is also already settled by four 2026 papers; repeating it is not a contribution, and tasks needing code execution or web navigation cannot be run here at all.

required_output.terminal_rule: first supported => T1; ten scientifically decided without supported => T2
measurement_requirements: name the specific claim being re-measured, with its source
report the unmodified-input baseline and the candidate under an equal generation budget, and report per-method max_new_tokens
a paired significance test with its permutation count
report metered tokens per arm so accuracy per token is computable
retain raw predictions so an arm that generated nothing cannot pass as a refutation
